entities.name: UL Dedicated Message Segment Transfer
entities.description: Procedure to transfer segments of UL DCCH messages from UE to NG-RAN in RRC_CONNECTED state. Segmentation is only applicable to UECapabilityInformation and MeasurementReportAppLayer in this release.

entities.name: ULDedicatedMessageSegment
entities.description: Message used to transfer segments of UL DCCH messages from UE to network.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE is connected to NG-RAN.

entities.name: UECapabilityInformation
entities.description: UL DCCH message that can be segmented using the UL dedicated message segment procedure.

entities.name: MeasurementReportAppLayer
entities.description: UL DCCH message that can be segmented using the UL dedicated message segment procedure.

relations.description: The UL dedicated message segment transfer procedure involves sending the ULDedicatedMessageSegment message.
The UL dedicated message segment transfer procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
ULDedicatedMessageSegment can contain segments of UECapabilityInformation message.
ULDedicatedMessageSegment can contain segments of MeasurementReportAppLayer message.
